problem_type: Presentation overrides can displace a node's functional workspace/card body
symptom: Historical whiteboard/audio nodes carrying shot-frame lose the whiteboard launcher or audio controls and fixed geometry after the broad intrinsic-return removal.
direct_cause: The prior correction treated whiteboard/audio like character/scene presentation choices. Explicit metadata now returns before the functional kind-owned card, making isCardRenderKind false and preventing NodeCardBody from mounting.
class_root: Render ownership must distinguish function-bearing bodies from selectable presentation. Persistent display metadata cannot remove a whiteboard editor or audio upload/playback/transcript surface; character/scene presentation remains selectable.
affected_population: Already persisted V51/V60 whiteboard/audio + shot-frame nodes
Functional whiteboard/audio nodes with any incompatible stored display card value
Card/body/size/history/ReactFlow consumers of the shared resolver
internal_only_reason: This internal ownership rule is established by actual registry, shell, card dispatcher, whiteboard/audio bodies, historical migration source and the user's precise counterexample. Existing React SSR is used only to execute actual consumers; no dependency behavior or upgrade is changed.
invariants: Whiteboard always resolves to its functional whiteboard-card; audio to audio-strip regardless of incompatible persisted presentation metadata
Character/scene still honor every declared explicit render kind before their defaults
Keep all existing editor/asset/Agent-artifact/storyboard-table protections and category defaults
Actual whiteboard open and audio upload/playback/transcript/copy/subtitle controls remain rendered
Audio geometry remains 420x80 and functional sizes equal clean-node geometry
Do not mutate stored renderKind, user meta/results or any persistent data; no feature deletion, model/frozen/PNG/metadata edits

door_reduction.why_not: Shell, sizing, history and ReactFlow are legitimate independent consumers that already use the same resolver. Fix functional ownership once there; do not add caller-side guards or merge unrelated UI lifecycles.

generality_proof: Exact shot-frame counterexamples and all declared display values are executed for both functional kinds, while character/scene explicit matrices remain. Real NodeCardBody with real WhiteboardCardBody and AudioStripNode is streamed through React SSR in Chinese/English; only the closed heavy whiteboard modal is mocked and throws if incorrectly mounted. Upload, playback, transcript/copy/subtitle and frozen input/result identity are checked. Existing sizing consumes the resolver and verifies clean/polluted geometry equality.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Protect function-bearing card ownership before explicit presentation choices, then retain intrinsic/category defaults

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Actual shell only mounts the card dispatcher for a card result; there is no whiteboard kind fallback. The real dispatcher and actual functional bodies are executed in SSR regression.
The same resolver chooses cardFixedSize; actual size regression checks audio 420x80 and clean/polluted geometry.
Current migration avoids new category pollution for these kinds but does not remove already stored explicit shot-frame. It is not changed; render-time ownership must remain protective.

recurrence.reason: Any stored generic/category render kind can hide a functional body, across both node kinds and multiple consumer surfaces. The previous four-kind explicit matrix encoded an overbroad assumption.
same_class_scan: Read registry whiteboard/audio entries and complete shell -> card dispatcher -> actual functional body chain
Read current migration prevention and retained explicit metadata behavior
Read actual audio fixed-size consumer and existing protected workspace tests
Replaced the incorrect functional explicit-override matrix with a stronger functional-ownership matrix; retained character/scene choices

prevention.invariant: Function-bearing whiteboard/audio card identity wins before stored presentation choice; selectable character/scene identity does not.
prevention.failure_mode: Incompatible presentation metadata cannot make the dispatcher skip functional controls or make audio geometry drift.
prevention.strategy: Use the existing intrinsic map once and protect only the two function-bearing kinds before explicit selection, keeping later default lookup and every other hard boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove the overbroad behavior where a presentation override displaces functional whiteboard/audio bodies; keep all APIs and stored values.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Reuse existing pure resolver, map and React SSR test APIs; no production dependency/runtime upgrade or API substitution.

migration: No data rewrite. Old explicit fields remain byte-for-byte in the test inputs and actual stored result values are preserved. The existing rendering boundary chooses a safe functional body.
residual_risks: No full ReactFlow/App mounting, pointer activation, Leafer drawing, actual audio decoding, Provider or PNG acceptance is run; actual card bodies are verified by SSR, not a real screenshot
The closed WhiteboardModal is mocked only to avoid loading the heavy canvas; the real WhiteboardCardBody and AudioStripNode are not mocked

Door-map enumerates callers, not the resolver definition itself; retain actual generated consumers and report any resulting owner-definition coverage advisory without fake self-calls or checker changes
